prompt: A flat, bleached, slightly wide frame from a small lens mounted in the top corner of an ambulance's rear compartment, looking down along the length of the stretcher. Brandon lies on it with his arm wrapped in thick white bandage and strapped across his chest, his other hand clutching a plastic protein shake bottle, brows raised, eyelids heavy, mouth pressed shut, eyes aimed at Sophie. Sophie sits on the jump seat to his left in her green paramedic uniform, leaning in with one hand reaching for the bottle, her brows slightly lowered, eyelids tired, mouth soft. A cold white strip light above them washes out colour, and cabinets with latches and folded blankets line the walls. Nothing is written on the picture. Thanks.
